template.name: SearchNodesAdvancedFiltering
template.description: Advanced node search with attribute filters, relation filters, and comprehensive filtering options for complex data discovery and analysis.

content.description: Text to search for in node content

tableId.description: Optional table ID to limit search scope

attributeId.description: ID of the attribute to filter by

relationTypeId.description: ID of the relation type to filter by

targetNodeId.description: Optional target node ID for relationship filtering

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination
